containerOverrides.name: backend
command: cd /app && if ! command -v sqlx &> /dev/null; then curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y && source $HOME/.cargo/env && cargo install sqlx-cli --features postgres --no-default-features; fi && sqlx migrate run --database-url "$DATABASE_URL" && echo 'Migrations completed successfully'
